info.inspired_by: Moscow workers' clubs of 1925-30 (Melnikov, Golosov): a glazed cylinder of foyer and stair with hall wings radiating at different heights, one cantilevered over the door, roof lettering, a red stair tower; massing and details are our own

frame: x along the street front, y into the plot, z up; origin on the front line, mid-frontage, z 0 = ground at the main entrance
notes: drum with spiral stair, 5 wings at different heights, front wing cantilevered over the entrance
